title: Optimizing Real-Time Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for Dynamic 3D Scene Rendering on Consumer GPUs
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have revolutionized 3D scene reconstruction. However, their extreme computational complexity makes real-time rendering on consumer-grade GPUs challenging. This paper introduces an optimized framework utilizing dynamic VRAM pruning and predictive ray marching, achieving 60+ FPS at 1080p resolution on a consumer GPU while reducing VRAM usage by 42%.
